findings.title: Live search untested
findings.detail: applyQuery sets submitted on every keystroke, changing filter semantics from submit-only to live-narrow. The acceptance suite only retargets data-testid from sitter-list to search-results; nothing in the diff asserts that typing without form submit reduces result count. The behavior change is unverified.

findings.title: Hero measure on intro paragraph
findings.detail:
data-measure="hero" is on a page-intro

, not a primary painted hero or full content surface. Harnesses that sample [data-measure=hero] for painted width will measure short intro text, not the catalog column, so desktop-width claims are not proven and may be gamed.

findings.title: search-results rename incomplete in diff
findings.detail: data-testid renames sitter-list to search-results. Only tests/acceptance.spec.ts is updated in this commit. Other consumers (other specs, audit manifests, measure scripts) are not shown; completeness of the rename cannot be verified from the diff alone.

findings.title: compact-header on full topbar
findings.detail: The main sticky topbar (brand + primary nav) is labeled data-testid="compact-header". That name implies a compact/mobile header, not the full shell header; harnesses keyed to compact-header may pass against the wrong surface.

findings.title: Mark measure is not brand proof
findings.detail: Only adds data-measure="mark". The image asset, source, and alt are unchanged; a real non-placeholder brand mark is not verified by instrumentation alone.

findings.title: No measurement or visual evidence
findings.detail: The commit is almost entirely data-testid/data-measure wiring plus a live-filter hook. No screenshots, measure run output, or cold-visitor proof is in the diff. Gate-facing instrumentation does not pass until those artifacts exist and are inspected.
